title: Resource alerts
description: Sends a notification when CPU or memory stays above a threshold for a set time, and again when it is back to normal. Checked once a minute from the stored metrics.

hint.cpu: Percent of one CPU core, so it can go above 100 on several cores.
hint.cpuLimit: Percent of one CPU core. The container is limited to {cores} cores.
hint.memory: Percent of the memory limit. No limit is set, so this is the host's RAM.
hint.memoryLimit: Percent of the {limit} MB memory limit.

note: No alerts are sent while it is stopped or deploying. A reminder is sent every 6 hours while the value stays high.
